42P8: All the Gurmukh's affairs are brought to perfect completion; the Lord has showered him with His Mercy.
To whom the Exalted Guru shows mercy, all their affairs are adjusted.
90XR: O Nanak, one who meets the Primal Lord remains blended with the Lord, the Creator Lord. ||2||
Nanak, they, whom God the creator unites, meet the primal Lord and remain blended with him.
KG12: You are True, O True Lord and Master. You are the Truest of the True, O Lord of the World.
You O True Lord, are True. The truest of the True You are, O World-Lord.
5UQS: Everyone meditates on You; everyone falls at Your Feet.
Everyone remembers You, all falls at Yours feet.
NTQC: Your Praises are graceful and beautiful; You save those who speak them.
Graceful, and home of beauty, is Your praise. You savest him who celebrates it.
7D0T: You reward the Gurmukhs, who are absorbed in the True Name.
You givest reward to the holy, and they get absorbed in the True Name.
2XR2: O my Great Lord and Master, great is Your glorious greatness. ||1||
O my great Lord, great is Yours greatness.
BDQM: Without the Name, all other praise and speech is insipid and tasteless.
The taste of praising anything but the Name and all other talk is insipid.
112M: The self-willed manmukhs praise their own egos; their attachment to egotism is useless.
The perverse praise their pride, but in vain is the love of self-conceit.
6RFK: Those whom they praise, die; they all waste away in conflict.
They, whom they praise, die away. All of them pine away in wranglings.
13LF: O servant Nanak, the Gurmukhs are saved, chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the Embodiment of Supreme Bliss. ||1||
O servant Nanak, the holy are saved by pondering on Lord God, the Embodiment of Supreme Bliss.
U3K1: O True Guru, tell me of my Lord God, that I may meditate on the Naam within my mind.
My True Guru, tell me of the Lord Master, that, in my, mind, I may meditate upon His Name.
KA79: O Nanak, the Lord's Name is sacred and pure; chanting it, all my pain has been taken away. ||2||
By repeating with my mouth, the sacred Name of God, O Nanak, I may shake off all my agonies.
AHYF: You Yourself are the Formless Lord, the Immaculate Lord, our Sovereign King.
O my formless, Immaculate God, the King, You are all by Your ownself.
488Z: Those who meditate on You, O True Lord with one-pointed mind, are rid of all their pain.
They who remember You with single mind, O True Lord them You riddest of all anguishes.
NCSD: You have no equal, next to whom I might sit and speak of You.
You have no equal, seating whom close by I may speak of You.
9DPL: You are the only Giver as great as Yourself. You are Immaculate; O True Lord, you are pleasing to my mind.
O pure Lord, You alone are as great a Donor, as Yourself. You O True One, are pleasing to my mind.
JQFM: O my True Lord and Master, Your Name is the Truest of the True. ||2||
O my True Lord, Truest of the True is Yours Name.
536T: Deep within the mind is the disease of ego; the self-willed manmukhs, the evil beings, are deluded by doubt.
In the mind of the evil perverse persons is the disease of pride, and they are gone astray in doubt.
UHGU: O Nanak, this disease is eradicated, only when one meets the True Guru, our Holy Friend. ||1||
Nanak, by meeting the saintly Satguru, the friend, they get the disease eradicated.
522D: The mind and body of the Gurmukh are imbued with the Love of the Lord, the Treasure of Virtue.
The mind and body of the pious person are dyed, with the love of God, the treasure of virtues.
F4EV: Servant Nanak has taken to the Sanctuary of the Lord. Hail to the Guru, who has united me with the Lord. ||2||
Servant Nanak has sought God's shelter. Hail, to the Guru who has united him with God.
UXFD: You are the Personification of Creativity, the Inaccessible Lord. With whom should I compare You?
You are the Omnipotent and inaccessible Creator, with whom should I compare You?
8SAR: If there was anyone else as great as You, I would name him; You alone are like Yourself.
Were there anyone as great as You, I may Name him. You alone are said to be like You.
T5YP: You are the One, permeating each and every heart; You are revealed to the Gurmukh.
In every heart, You are contained alike. Through the Guru, You becomest manifest.
MYJC: You are the True Lord and Master of all; You are the Highest of all.
You are the True Lord of all. You are the highest of all as well.
7TS9: Whatever You do, O True Lord - that is what happens, so why should we grieve? ||3||
When, what You doest, O True Lord, that alone happens, then why should we grieve?
8PGV: My mind and body are imbued with the Love of my Beloved, twenty-four hours a day.
The whole day long, my soul and body remain imbued with the love of my Beloved.
MTVB: Shower Your Mercy upon servant Nanak, O God, that he may dwell in peace with the True Guru. ||1||
Show mercy onto slave Nanak, O Lord, that he may abide in peace by meeting the Satguru.
K85W: Those whose inner beings are filled with the Love of their Beloved, look beautiful as they speak.
Within whose heart is the love of the Darling, they look beauteous then, when they repeat Lord's praise.
TZWZ: O Nanak, the Lord Himself knows all; the Beloved Lord has infused His Love. ||2||
Nanak, God the Beloved, who has infused His affection in them, Himself, knows all this.
6G56: O Creator Lord, You Yourself are infallible; You never make mistakes.
You Yourself, O Creator, are infallible. You can't be in any wrong.
1ZN8: Whatever You do is good, O True Lord; this understanding is obtained through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
O True One, whatever You doest that is good. By Guru's instruction this understanding is obtained.
0SRP: You are the Cause of causes, the All-powerful Lord; there is no other at all.
You are competent to do all the works. There is no other than You.
ALK5: O Lord and Master, You are inaccessible and merciful. Everyone meditates on You.
You my Lord are inaccessible and Merciful. Everyone thinks of you.

397X: All beings are Yours; You belong to all. You deliver all. ||4||
All the beings are Yours and You belongest to all. You deliverest one and all.
9TCQ: Listen, O my Friend, to my message of love; my eyes are fixed upon You.
Hear, O my Friend, the message of love. My eyes glance is fixed on You.
2EP1: The Guru was pleased - He united servant Nanak with his friend, and now he sleeps in peace. ||1||
Being pleased, the Guru has united servant Nanak with the Friend, and he now sleeps in peace.
6NLS: The True Guru is the Merciful Giver; He is always compassionate.
The generous True Guru is merciful. He ever, feels compassion.
647K: The True Guru has no hatred within Him; He beholds the One God everywhere.
The True Guru is Uninimical from within and beholds that Unique Lord everywhere.
MM6M: Anyone who directs hate against the One who has no hate, shall never be satisfied within.
None of those, who bear enmity to the Uninimical, gets satiated.
KYH7: The True Guru wishes everyone well; how can anything bad happen to Him?
The True Guru wished well of everyone. How can evil befall him?
QGDP: As one feels towards the True Guru, so are the rewards he receives.
As anyone feels towards the True Guru, so is the fruit he gets.
1S0W: O Nanak, the Creator knows everything; nothing can be hidden from Him. ||2||
Nanak, the Creator, from whom nothing can remain hidden knows everything.
VZ4T: One who has been made great by his Lord and Master - know him to be great!
Know him alone to be great whom the Lord makes great.
CR27: By His Pleasure, the Lord and Master forgives those who are pleasing to His Mind.
The Lord pardons him whom He wishes, and he becomes pleasing to Lord's mind.
HBAS: One who tries to compete with Him is a senseless fool.
He, who rivals him, is an insensate fool.
XQNY: One who is united with the Lord by the True Guru, sings His Praises and speaks His Glories.
He, whom the Satguru unites with the Lord, sings His praises and utters and narrates His excellences.
4N8R: O Nanak, the True Lord is True; one who understands Him is absorbed in Truth. ||5||
Nanak, the True One alone is True. He who understands Him is absorbed in Truth.
JMYZ: The Lord is true, immaculate and eternal; He has no fear, hatred or form.
God is True, Immaculate, Eternal, Fearless, without enmity and Formless.
TWLT: Those who chant and meditate on Him, who single-mindedly focus their consciousness on Him, are rid of the burden of their ego.
They, who contemplate over Him with single mind and single heart, get rid of the load of pride.
JKBR: Those Gurmukhs who worship and adore the Lord - hail to those Saintly beings!
Hail, to the saintly persons, who, through the Guru, have mediated on God.
1152: If someone slanders the Perfect True Guru, he will be rebuked and reproached by the whole world.
If someone slanders the Perfect Satguru, him the whole world rebukes and reproaches.
0VVX: The Lord Himself abides within the True Guru; He Himself is His Protector.
Within the Satguru, God himself abides, and Himself is his protector.
LYJ6: Blessed, Blessed is the Guru, who sings the Glories of God. To Him, I bow forever and ever in deepest reverence.
Blest! blest! is the Guru, who sings Lord's praises. To him ever, ever and ever, I make an obeisance.
33U3: Servant Nanak is a sacrifice to those who have meditated on the Creator Lord. ||1||
Slave Nanak is a sacrifice to those, who have contemplated over their creator.
TRJ2: He Himself made the earth; He Himself made the sky.
God Himself has made the earth and Himself the sky.
MBLE: He Himself created the beings there, and He Himself places food in their mouths.
He of himself created the beings therein, and of Himself puts morsels (food) in their mouths.
VYCC: He Himself is All-pervading; He Himself is the Treasure of Excellence.
All by Himself He pervades everywhere and Himself is the Treasure of excellences.
M0P2: O servant Nanak, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; He shall take away all your sinful mistakes. ||2||
Remember You God's Name, O slave Nanak, and He shall efface all yours sins.
2HSZ: You, O True Lord and Master, are True; the Truth is pleasing to the True One.
You, O True Lord, are True. The truth is pleasing to the True one.
SZ8J: The Messenger of Death does not even approach those who praise You, O True Lord.
Death's myrmidon draws not near them, who praise You, O True Lord.
5BBR: Their faces are radiant in the Court of the Lord; the Lord is pleasing to their hearts.
The faces of those to whose mind the True Lord is pleasing, sparkle in His court.
BMSJ: The false ones are left behind; because of the falsehood and deceit in their hearts, they suffer in terrible pain.
The false are pushed behind, because of falsehood and deceit in their mind they suffer great pain.
QH62: Black are the faces of the false; the false remain just false. ||6||
Black are the faces of the lairs. The false remain but false.
H40U: The True Guru is the field of Dharma; as one plants the seeds there, so are the fruits obtained.
The True Guru is the field of faith. As a man sows there-in, so does he gather the fruit.
BGPE: The GurSikhs plant ambrosial nectar, and obtain the Lord as their ambrosial fruit.
The Guru's Sikhs sow Nectar and obtain God as their Necterean fruit.
K1FS: Their faces are radiant in this world and the next; in the Court of the Lord, they are robed with honor.
Their faces are bright in this world and the next one. In God's true court they are clothed with robe of honour.
JFPE: Some have cruelty in their hearts - they constantly act in cruelty; as they plant, so are the fruits which they eat.
Some have malice in their heart they ever act maliciously. As they plant, so is the fruit they eat.

LHL6: When the True Guru, the Tester, observes with His Glance, the selfish ones are all exposed.
All the self-servers are laid bare, when Satguru, the tester, sees with the searching glance.
GBGZ: As one thinks, so does he receive, and so does the Lord make him known.
As they meditate, so do they, ever, obtain, and so God makes them known.
LEPC: O Nanak, the Lord and Master is pervading at both ends; He continually acts, and beholds His own play. ||1||
Nanak, the Lord Himself pervades both (the good and bad) ends. He ever, enacts and beholds various plays.
AJS9: The mortal is of one mind - whatever he dedicates it to, in that he is successful.
The one Lord is contained in every man. Whatever he attaches with, in that he succeeds
RE18: Some talk a lot, but they eat only that which is in their own homes.
The mortal may talk much, yet he eats only the article which is in his home.
KDZH: Without the True Guru, understanding is not obtained, and egotism does not depart from within.
Without the True Guru, understanding is not obtained, nor does pride depart from within.
DZ2T: Suffering and hunger cling to the egotistical people; they hold out their hands and beg from door to door.
Anguish and hunger cling to the proud. They put out their hand and beg from hose to house.
CB80: Their falsehood and fraud cannot remain concealed; their false appearances fall off in the end.
Falsehood and fraud remain not concealed. Gliding and adulteration do finally fail.
5WPE: One who has such pre-ordained destiny comes to meet God through the True Guru.
The Lord incarnate Satguru comes and meets him who is so fated from the beginning.
GHZ6: Just as iron is transmuted into gold by the touch of the Philosopher's Stone, so are people transformed by joining the Sangat, the Holy Congregation.
As iron becomes gold by touching the philosopher's stone, so does man become invaluable by meeting Guru's congregation.
JV9E: O God, You are the Master of servant Nanak; as it pleases You, You lead him. ||2||
O Lord, You are the Master of slave Nanak. As You willest, so doest You lead him.
AHDX: One who serves the Lord with all his heart - the Lord Himself unites him with Himself.
Who heartily serve Lord, him the Lord unites with Himself.
E5CH: He enters into a partnership with virtue and merit, and burns off all his demerits with the fire of the Shabad.
I entered into partnership of merits with them and burn all the demerits with the fire of God's Name.
0C83: Demerits are purchased cheap, like straw; he alone gathers merit, who is so blessed by the True Lord.
The sins are brought cheap like straw. He alone obtains the virtues, whom the true Lord gives.
90DG: I am a sacrifice to my Guru, who has erased my demerits, and revealed my virtuous merits.
Devoted am I to my Guru, who effacing sins has manifested virtues to me.
6XRP: The Gurmukh chants the glorious greatness of the great Lord God. ||7||
The Guru-ward utters the great glory of the great Lord.
6BD5: Great is the greatness within the True Guru, who meditates night and day on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
Great is the greatness in the True Guru, who night and day ponders on the Name of Lord God.
VC5G: The repetition of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is his purity and self-restraint; with the Name of the Lord, He is satisfied.
The repetition of Lord Master's Name alone is his purity and self-restraint. With God's Name he is sated.
JR83: The Lord's Name is His power, and the Lord's Name is His Royal Court; the Lord's Name protects Him.
God's Name is his power and God's Name his prop. God's Name alone protects him.
EVG1: One who centers his consciousness and worships the Guru, obtains the fruits of his mind's desires.
He who heartily adores Guru's being obtains the boons his heart desires.
E9GS: But one who slanders the Perfect True Guru, shall be killed and destroyed by the Creator.
Who slanders the perfect True Guru him the Creator destroys.
JZX6: This opportunity shall not come into his hands again; he must eat what he himself has planted.
That opportunity comes not his hand again. He Himself eats what he himself has sown.
2UB1: He shall be taken to the most horrible hell, with his face blackened like a thief, and a noose around his neck.
Putting a halter round his neck, he shall be taken to the terrible hell with blackened face, like a thief.
Y224: But if he should again take to the Sanctuary of the True Guru, and meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, then he shall be saved.
When he again seeks, Satguru's protection and remembers Lord God's Name then is he saved.
153Q: Nanak speaks and proclaims the Lord's Story; as it pleases the Creator, so does he speak. ||1||
Nanak utters and announces the proceeding of God's court. So it pleases God the Creator.
A3N1: One who does not obey the Hukam, the Command of the Perfect Guru - that self-willed manmukh is plundered by his ignorance and poisoned by Maya.
He who obeys not the Perfect Guru's order is perverse and robbed by ignorance and poisonous mammon.
LCK9: Within him is falsehood, and he sees everyone else as false; the Lord has tied these useless conflicts around his neck.
In his mind is falsehood and he deems everyone as false. The Lord has fastened superfluous strifes round his neck.
3WTT: He babbles on and on, but the words he speaks please no one.
He prattles a good deal, but what he says pleases no one.
3LZW: He wanders from house to house like an abandoned woman; whoever associates with him is stained by the mark of evil as well.
He wanders from house to house like an abandoned woman, whosoever associates with him, he too comes to bear evil mark.
3RXT: Those who become Gurmukh avoid him; they forsake his company and sit near the Guru.
Those turned Guru-wards, keep aloof from him. They leave his association and sit near the Guru.

LKMC: O chosen people, O self-elect, one who does not publicly affirm his Guru is not a good person; he loses all his profits and capital.
He who avows not publicly his Guru is not a good person. He loses all his capital and profit O Saints.
JM9N: People used to chant and recite the Shaastras and the Vedas, O Nanak, but now the Words of the Perfect Guru have come to be the most exalted of all.
Nanak previously the mortals recited and preached the Shastras and Vedas, but the Gurbani of the Perfect Guru has descended as the most exalted of all.
9D9D: The glorious greatness of the Perfect Guru is pleasing to the GurSikh; the self-willed manmukhs have lost this opportunity. ||2||
The eulogy of the perfect Guru is pleasing to the Sikhs of the Guru. The perverse have not that opportunity.
9WHP: The True Lord is truly the greatest of all; he alone obtains Him, who is anointed by the Guru.
Truly the True Lord is the most exalted. He alone obtains Him whom the True Guru nominates.
SX2M: He is the True Guru, who meditates on the True Lord. The True Lord and the True Guru are truly One.
He is the Satguru, who remembers the True Lord. True it is that the True Lord and the True Guru are one.
L251: He is the True Guru, the Primal Being, who has totally conquered his five passions.
He is the Omnipotent Satguru who has resolutely subdued his five evil passions.
HV83: One who does not serve the True Guru, and who praises himself, is filled with falsehood within. Cursed, cursed is his ugly face.
He who without serving the True Guru extols himself has falsehood within him. O curse and reproach be to his dry face.
FQN5: His words are not pleasing to anyone; his face is blackened, and he is separated from the True Guru. ||8||
He is separated from the True Guru. His face is blackened and his talk of pleasing to none.
7VLS: Everyone is the field of the Lord God; the Lord Himself cultivates this field.
Every body is the Lord God's filed. God Himself causes the tillage to be performed.
2DAJ: The Gurmukh grows the crop of forgiveness, while the self-willed manmukh loses even his roots.
The Guru-ward grows the crop of God's Grace. The perverse person loses even his capital.
GMWR: They all plant for their own good, but the Lord causes to grow only that field with which He is pleased.
Everyone cultivates for his own good. God causes that field to germinate which he likes.
L8RF: The GurSikh plants the seed of the Lord's Ambrosial Nectar, and obtains the Lord's Ambrosial Naam as his Ambrosial Fruit.
The disciple of the Guru sows God's elixir and obtains God's Nectarean Name as the ambrosial fruit.
8M7P: The mouse of Death is continually gnawing away at the crop, but the Creator Lord has beaten it off and driven it away.
The Death mouse ever gnaws the crop, but one God, the Creator, has beaten it off.
SPCT: The farm was successful, by the Love of the Lord, and the crop was produced by God's Grace.
By Lord's love the crop did succeed and the corn heap was produced through God's Grace.
49US: He has removed all the burning and anxiety of those, who have meditated on the True Guru, the Primal Being.
The Lord has removed all the burning and anxiety of those who have thought over the Omnipotent True Guru.
6NZK: O servant Nanak, one who worships and adores the Naam, the Name of the Lord, swims across, and saves the whole world as well. ||1||
O slave Nanak he who ponders on the Name swims across himself and saves the whole world.
49LJ: The self-willed manmukh is occupied with greed all day long, although he may claim otherwise.
The perverse person is all day occupied with avarice though he talks otherwise.
9EAJ: At night, he is overcome by fatigue, and all his nine holes are weakened.
At night he is over-powered by drowsiness and all his nine apertures get weakened.
EPES: Over the head of the manmukh is the order of the woman; to her, he ever holds out his promises of goodness.
On the head of an apostate is the order of the woman and he ever holds out good promises to her.
JRZY: Those men who act according to the orders of women are impure, filthy and foolish.
The men, who act as women tell them, are impure filthy and foolish.
FUUM: Those impure men are engrossed in sexual desire; they consult their women and walk accordingly.
The impure persons are engrossed in lust. They consult women and walk accordingly.
SRAK: One who walks as the True Guru tells him to, is the true man, the best of the best.
He who walks as the True Guru tells him he is the true man the best of the good.
DJAM: He Himself created all women and men; the Lord Himself plays every play.
He Himself has created all the women and men. God plays every play.
EFXC: You created the entire creation; O Nanak, it is the best of the best. ||2||
All the make that You have made, O Nanak is the best of the best.
65AJ: You are carefree, unfathomable and immeasurable; how can You be measured?
You O Lord are Care-free Unfathomable and Immeasurable. How can You be weighed
NC49: Those who have met the True Guru and who meditate on You are very fortunate.
They who remember You, O Lord, and whom the True Guru has met. are very fortunate.
U0HZ: The Word of the True Guru's Bani is the embodiment of Truth; through Gurbani, one becomes perfect.
The Gurbani if the Satguru is the embodiment of Truth. Through Gurbani the mortal becomes perfect.
Z4MT: Jealously emulating the True Guru, some others may speak of good and bad, but the false are destroyed by their falsehood.
By way of emulating the True Guru some others utter filth bad and good sermons but because of falsehood, those false ones soon get devastated.
VNJ9: Deep within them is one thing, and in their mouths is another; they suck in the poison of Maya, and then they painfully waste away. ||9||
In their heart is one thing and in their mouth is quite another. They hanker after and pine away for the poisonous wealth.
KXCH: Service to the True Guru is immaculate and pure; those humble beings who are pure perform this service.
Consecrated is your service of the True Guru The one who is pure he performs this service.
EFH4: Those who have deceit, corruption and falsehood within - the True Lord Himself casts them out like lepers.
They who have deceit, wickedness and falsehood in their mind, those lepers the True Lord Himself separates away.

98LB: The truthful Sikhs sit by the True Guru's side and serve Him. The false ones search, but find no place of rest.
The True Sikhs sit by the side of the Guru and serve him. The false ones find no place even through search.
9JA0: Those who are not pleased with the Words of the True Guru - their faces are cursed, and they wander around, condemned by God.
They to whom the words of the Satguru are not agreeable accursed are their countenances and condemned by God they wander about.
ANVR: Those who do not have the Love of the Lord within their hearts - how long can those demonic, self-willed manmukhs be consoled?
They who in their heart have not the love of God how long can those willful devils be consoled.
NCWM: One who meets the True Guru, keeps his mind in its own place; he spends only his own assets.
He who meets the True Guru keeps his mind fixed to its place. Furthermore his assets of God's Name he himself expends.
11PG: O servant Nanak, some are united with the Guru; to some, the Lord grants peace, while others - deceitful cheats - suffer in isolation. ||1||
Uniting with the Guru the Lord grants peace to some, O servant Nanak. Some cheats He Himself quarantines.
VZQV: Those who have the treasure of the Lord's Name deep within their hearts - the Lord resolves their affairs.
They who have the treasure of God's Name in their heart, the Lord causes their affairs to prosper.
LB9K: They are no longer subservient to other people; the Lord God sits by them, at their side.
They cease to be subservient to the people and taking their side the Lord God sits close to them.
4H5T: When the Creator is on their side, then everyone is on their side. Beholding their vision, everyone applauds them.
When the Creator is on their side then everyone is on their side. By seeing their sight everyone applauds them.
3MNG: Kings and emperors are all created by the Lord; they all come and bow in reverence to the Lord's humble servant.
Kings and emperors are all created by God. They all come and make obeisance to the Lord's servant.
BFFZ: Great is the greatness of the Perfect Guru. Serving the Great Lord, I have obtained immeasurable peace.
Great is the greatness of the perfect Guru by serving the great Lord I have obtained immeasurable peace.
JAHQ: The Lord has bestowed this eternal gift upon the Perfect Guru; His blessings increase day by day.
To the Perfect Guru the Lord has given the permanent gift and what He has given increases day by day,
CU7M: The slanderer, who cannot endure His greatness, is destroyed by the Creator Himself.
The Creator Himself destroys the Guru's slanderer, who cannot endure his greatness.
6ZXS: Servant Nanak chants the Glorious Praises of the Creator, who protects His devotees forever. ||2||
Slave Nanak utters the praises of the Creator who has ever been preserving His saints.
N827: You, O Lord and Master, are inaccessible and merciful; You are the Great Giver, All-knowing.
You O Unapproachable Kind and Wise Lord are the great Bestower.
XNAS: I can see no other as great as You; O Lord of Wisdom, You are pleasing to my mind.
I see none as great as You. You O wise Lord, are pleasing to my mind.
NEJN: Emotional attachment to your family and everything you see is temporary, coming and going.
The love of family, and all else that is seen are fleeting and subject to coming and going.
FTG3: Those who attach their consciousness to anything except the True Lord are false, and false is their pride.
They who attach their heart to any other than the True Lord are false and false is their pride.
1NH6: O Nanak, meditate on the True Lord; without the True Lord, the ignorant rot away and putrefy to death. ||10||
Meditate you on the True Lord, O Nanak. Without the True one the ignorant rot and putrefy to death.
DPJJ: At first, he did not show respect to the Guru; later, he offered excuses, but it is no use.
At first you did not show respect to the Guru. Yours making excuses afterwards is of no avail.
C2T6: The wretched, self-willed manmukhs wander around and are stuck mid-way; how can they find peace by mere words?
The wretched apostate wanders half-way. How can he obtain peace by mere words?
T5P0: Those who have no love for the True Guru within their hearts come with falsehood, and leave with falsehood.
He within whose heart is not the love of the True Guru, comes with a lie, and departs with a lie.
SS41: When my Lord God, the Creator, grants His Grace, then they come to see the True Guru as the Supreme Lord God.
If my Lord God the Creator shows His mercy then the man sees the Satguru, to be an embodiment of the Transcendent Lord.
KKR4: Then, they drink in the Nectar, the Word of the Guru's Shabad; all burning, anxiety, and doubts are eliminated.
He drinks then the Nectar of Guru's hymns and all his burning, anxiety and doubt are annulled.
ENUP: They remain in ecstasy forever, day and night; O servant Nanak, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, night and day. ||1||
Day and night, he, ever, remains happy and always sings the praises of God O slave Nanak.
V6AR: One who calls himself a Sikh of the Guru, the True Guru, shall rise in the early morning hours and meditate on the Lord's Name.
He, who calls himself a Sikh of the Great True Guru, should rise early and meditate on God's Name.
BJRV: Upon arising early in the morning, he is to bathe, and cleanse himself in the pool of nectar.
He should make efforts early in the morning take bath and have ablution in the tank of Nectar.
AMFL: Following the Instructions of the Guru, he is to chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. All sins, misdeeds and negativity shall be erased.
By repeating Lords God's Name under Guru's instruction all his sins misdeeds and accusations are wiped off.
BEPU: Then, at the rising of the sun, he is to sing Gurbani; whether sitting down or standing up, he is to meditate on the Lord's Name.
Afterwards at sun rise he sings Gurbani and while sitting or standing he meditates in God's Name.
B310: One who meditates on my Lord, Har, Har, with every breath and every morsel of food - that GurSikh becomes pleasing to the Guru's Mind.
The Guru's disciple who with every breath and morsel contemplates over my Lord God he becomes pleasing to Guru's mind.

2RQZ: That person, to whom my Lord and Master is kind and compassionate - upon that GurSikh, the Guru's Teachings are bestowed.
He to whom my Master becomes merciful to that disciple of his, the Guru imparts his instruction.
4F4C: Servant Nanak begs for the dust of the feet of that GurSikh, who himself chants the Naam, and inspires others to chant it. ||2||
Servant Nanak asks for the dust of the feet of that Sikh of the Guru, who himself contemplates on God's Name and makes others contemplate thereon.
D1E3: Those who meditate on You, O True Lord - they are very rare.
Rare are the ones who meditate on You, O True Lord.
9BCU: Those who worship and adore the One Lord in their conscious minds - through their generosity, countless millions are fed.
They who mentally and heartily contemplate on the Unique One through their auspiciousness myraids and millions are fed.
FL4E: All meditate on You, but they alone are accepted, who are pleasing to their Lord and Master.
All the creation ponders on You. Only they are accepted who are pleasing to the Lord.
T8Z9: Those who eat and dress without serving the True Guru die; after death, those wretched lepers are consigned to reincarnation.
The lepers who eat and dress without serving the True Guru, suffer transmigration after death.
MG96: In His Sublime Presence, they talk sweetly, but behind His back, they exude poison from their mouths.
In the presence of the Guru they talk sweetly but at his back they exude dissolved poison from their mouth.
LYXW: The evil-minded are consigned to separation from the Lord. ||11||
The evil-minded are separated by God.
EMS4: The faithless baymukh sent out his faithless servant, wearing a blue-black coat, filled with filth and vermin.
The unfaithful man puts on his unfaithful servant the blue-black patched coat filled with filth and vermin.
WKR5: No one in the world will sit near him; the self-willed manmukh fell into manure, and returned with even more filth covering him.
No one in the world allows him to sit near Him. He the apostate fell into ordure and returned with still more filth attached to him.
GJK2: The faithless baymukh was sent to slander and back-bite others, but when he went there, the faces of both he and his faithless master were blackened instead.
The apostate was sent to slander and back bite others but there too the faces of both the perverse persons were got blackened.
9E9D: It was immediately heard throughout the whole world, O Siblings of Destiny, that this faithless man, along with his servant, was kicked and beaten with shoes; in humiliation, they got up and returned to their homes.
It was instantly heard in the whole world my brethren that the willful man along with his servant was shoe-beaten. With addled brains they arose and returned home.
X07A: The faithless baymukh was not allowed to mingle with others; his wife and niece then brought him home to lie down.
The perverse person for the future, was not allowed to mix with society of the fathers in law of his children. Then his wife and niece went and brought him home again to lie down.
5K5M: He has lost both this world and the next; he cries out continually, in hunger and thirst.
He has lost both this world and the world hereafter, Hungry and thirsty he ever cries out.
L162: Blessed, blessed is the Creator, the Primal Being, our Lord and Master; He Himself sits and dispenses true justice.
Blessed blessed is the Omnipotent Lord the Creator who sitting in the judgement seat has Himself caused the real justice to be done.
3TM4: One who slanders the Perfect True Guru is punished and destroyed by the True Lord.
Him who slanders the Perfect True Guru the True Lord punishes and destroys.
47XQ: This Word is spoken by the One who created the whole universe. ||1||
This Word is uttered by Him who has created the whole world.
V6CC: One who has a poor beggar for a master - how can he be well-fed?
He whose Master is a pauper; whence can his servant eat to repletion?
7161: If there is something in his master's house, he can get it; but how can he get what is not there?
If there be something in the Master's house that his servant can get but wherefrom can he get what there is not?
6QKM: Serving him, who will be called to answer for his account? That service is painful and useless.
By performing whose service the account is still called for that service is hurtful indeed,
K4MM: O Nanak, serve the Guru, the Lord Incarnate; the Blessed Vision of His Darshan is profitable, and in the end, you shall not be called to account. ||2||
Nanak perform you the service of the Divine Guru whose very sight is profitable and no account shall, afterwards be taken from you.
0XS9: O Nanak, the Saints consider, and the four Vedas proclaim,
Nanak, the holy men think and the four Vedas tell,
BK12: that whatever the Lord's devotees utter with their mouths, shall come to pass.
that the words which the saints utter with their mouth come to pass.
7CBH: He is manifest in His cosmic workshop. All people hear of this.
In His workshop, He appears manifest. All people hear of it.
QCG9: The stubborn men who fight with the Saints shall never find peace.
The pigheaded persons who tussle with the saints obtain not peace.
24DK: The Saints seek to bless them with virtue, but they only burn in their egos.
They (the saints) desire virtues for them but they burn with pride.
BMX5: What can those wretched ones do, since, from the very beginning, their destiny is cursed with evil.
What can those wretched do, since from the very beginning their fate is evil?
Z6EY: Those who are struck down by the Supreme Lord God are of no use to anyone.
They who are smitten by the Supreme Lord are of no one's property.
GXBE: Those who hate the One who has no hatred - according to the true justice of Dharma, they shall perish.
It is real justice that they who bear enmity with the Uninimical should perish.
JNDL: Those who are cursed by the Saints will continue wandering aimlessly.
They whom the saints have cursed continue wandering about.
EG5K: When the tree is cut off at its roots, the branches wither and die. ||12||
When the tree is cut by the roots its branches wither off.

3SPV: Great is the greatness of the Guru, who meditates on the Lord within.
Grate is the greatness of the Guru, who within his mind contemplates over God.
FB4K: By His Pleasure, the Lord has bestowed this upon the Perfect True Guru; it is not diminished one bit by anyone's efforts.
By His pleasure the Lord has given it to the perfect Satguru. By any one's diminishing it diminishes not even by an iota.
CBUS: The True Lord and Master is on the side of the True Guru; and so, all those who oppose Him waste away to death in anger, envy and conflict.
The True Lord is on the side of the True Guru. Then all the men opposed to the Satguru, worry and die.
5Y8L: The Lord, the Creator, blackens the faces of the slanderers, and increases the glory of the Guru.
God the Creator blackens the countenances of the slanderers Guru's glory He Himself increases.
4RF0: As the slanderers spread their slander, so does the Guru's glory increase day by day.
As the calumniators, calumniate the Guru so does his glory magnify day by day.
Y402: Servant Nanak worships the Lord, who makes everyone fall at His Feet. ||1||
Slave Nanak has meditated on God who has made everyone fall at his feet.
60Y9: One who enters into a calculated relationship with the True Guru loses everything, this world and the next.
He who enters into reckoning with the True Guru loses all this world and the world hereafter.
QRYG: He grinds his teeth continually and foams at the mouth; screaming in anger, he perishes.
He ever grinds his teeth, foams at his mouth and perishes talking wildly.
4CF4: He continually chases after Maya and wealth, but even his own wealth flies away.
He, ever strives for riches and wealth but even his former wealth flees away.
G3MW: What shall he earn, and what shall he eat? Within his heart, there is only cynicism and pain.
What shall he earn and what shall he eat, in whose heart is the pain of anxiety.
CPGW: One who hates the One who has no hatred, shall bear the load of all the sins of the world on his head.
He who bears enmity to the Uninimical one bears all the sins of the world on his head.
8F8Y: He shall find no shelter here or hereafter; his mouth blisters with the slander in his heart.
He whose mouth blisters by uttering the slander of his heart, finds no shelter here and hereafter.
GFM7: If gold comes into his hands, it turns to dust.
If he handles gold then it turns into and mixes with dust.
T40X: But if he should come again to the Sanctuary of the Guru, then even his past sins shall be forgiven.
If he again enters Guru's protection then his previous sins are pardoned.
XUEG: Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, night and day. Remembering the Lord in meditation, wickedness and sins are erased. ||2||
Servant Nanak has night and day meditated on the Name. By remembering God the sins and wickedness are erased. (excused).
UE5J: You are the Truest of the True; Your Regal Court is the most exalted of all.
You are the Truest of the true The most exalted is yours court.
HJV6: Those who meditate on You, O True Lord, serve the Truth; O True Lord, they take pride in You.
They who contemplate over You O True Lord work for truth You O true one are their just pride.
KFEA: Within them is the Truth; their faces are radiant, and they speak the Truth. O True Lord, You are their strength.
Within them is truth their faces are bright they tell the truth and You O True One are their might.
3QET: Those who, as Gurmukh, praise You are Your devotees; they have the insignia and the banner of the Shabad, the True Word of God.
They alone are the saints, who through the Guru, praise You and who possess the standard of True Name.
JWKD: I am truly a sacrifice, forever devoted to those who serve the True Lord. ||13||
Truly, I am devoted and ever a sacrifice to those who serve the True Lord.
MVB3: Those who were cursed by the Perfect True Guru, from the very beginning, are even now cursed by the True Guru.
They who were blighted by the Perfect Satguru from the beginning have now been cursed by the True Guru.
6PKM: Even though they may have a great longing to associate with the Guru, the Creator does not allow it.
The Creator allows them not to meet the Satguru, even though they may desire much to associate with him.
FP11: They shall not find shelter in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation; in the Sangat, the Guru has proclaimed this.
In the society of saints they find no shelter. Thus the Guru has expressed his opinion in the guild of saints.
JUU3: Whoever goes out to meet them now, will be destroyed by the tyrant, the Messenger of Death.
Whosoever goes and meets them now him the tyrant courier of death destroys.
E6HM: Those who were condemned by Guru Nanak were declared counterfeit by Guru Angad as well.
They who were cursed by the Primal Guru remained cursed and were declared counterfeit by Guru Angad Dev.
84H4: The Guru of the third generation thought, "What lies in the hands of these poor people?"
The Guru in the third generation thought "What does lie in the hand of these poor people?"
MRZ1: The Guru of the fourth generation saved all these slanderers and evil-doers.
The Satguru, who nominated the Guru in the fourth generation, he saved all the slanderers and miscreants.
TF1L: If any son or Sikh serves the True Guru, then all of his affairs will be resolved.
Let any son or disciple of the True Guru, perform his service, then all his affairs, the Guru sets aright.
WFXS: He obtains the fruits of his desires - children, wealth, property, union with the Lord and emancipation.
He who takes and dedicates his children property and wealth to the Guru obtains the desired boons and him the Lord floats across the life-sea.
MFL4: All treasures are in the True Guru, who has enshrined the Lord within the heart.
All the treasures are in the True Guru who has installed God within his mind.
4X16: He alone obtains the Perfect True Guru, on whose forehead such blessed destiny is pre-ordained.
He alone obtains the Perfect True Guru on whose brow an auspicious writ is recorded.
BY05: Servant Nanak begs for the dust of the feet of those GurSikhs who love the Lord, their Friend. ||1||
Servant Nanak prays for the dust of the feet of those Sikhs of the Guru, who are sweet to God the Friend.

PLGY: The Lord Himself bestows glorious greatness; He Himself causes the world to come and fall at their feet.
They whom the Lord Himself gives greatness He Himself brings the world as well to fall at their feet.
WFV6: We should only be afraid, if we try to do things by ourselves; the Creator is increasing His Power in every way.
Then alone we may fear if we do anything ourselves. The Creator is in every way magnifying His might.
A68J: Behold, O Siblings of Destiny: this is the Arena of the Beloved True Lord; His power brings everyone to bow in humility.
Look, brethren, this is the arena of the beloved True God who by His power has brought all to bow.
JLEW: The Lord, our Lord and Master, preserves and protects His devotees; He blackens the faces of the slanderers and evil-doers.
The Lord God preserves His saints and gets blackened the countenances of the slanderers and the villains.
BGQF: The glorious greatness of the True Guru increases day by day; the Lord inspires His devotees to continually sing the Kirtan of His Praises.
The greatness of the True Guru increases day by day. The Lord ever Himself causes His saints to celebrate His praise.
N5GE: O GurSikhs, chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, night and day; through the True Guru, the Creator Lord will come to dwell within the home of your inner being.
Night and day repeat the Name, O you Sikhs, of the Guru and through the True Guru, implant God the Creator in your hearts.
M5UG: O GurSikhs, know that the Bani, the Word of the True Guru, is true, absolutely true. The Creator Lord Himself causes the Guru to chant it.
O the disciples of the Guru know that the Satguru's hymns are perfectly true. God the Creator Himself causes the Guru to utter them with his mouth.
KHYF: The Beloved Lord makes the faces of His GurSikhs radiant; He makes the whole world applaud and acclaim the Guru.
The beloved God makes bright the faces of the disciples of the Guru and causes the whole world to pay homage to the Guru.
3FRY: Servant Nanak is the slave of the Lord; the Lord Himself preserves the honor of His slave. ||2||
Servant Nanak is the servant of God. Of the God's servants God Himself preserves the honour.
0UKB: O My True Lord and Master, You Yourself are my True Lord King.
O my true King, You Yourself are my True Lord.
Q65A: Please, implant within me the true treasure of Your Name; O God, I am Your merchant.
My Master I am a merchant of Yours. Implant in me the genuine capital of Yours Name.
9937: I serve the True One, and deal in the True One; I chant Your Wondrous Praises.
I serve the True One, deal in truth and utter the praise of the wonderous Lord.
SDUM: Those humble beings who serve the Lord with love meet Him; they are adorned with the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
The persons who are adorned with the Guru-given Name, meet the Master by imbibing the sentiments of a slave.
2G84: O my True Lord and Master, You are unknowable; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, You are known. ||14||
You O True Lord, are Incomprehensible. Through Guru's Word alone You are comprehended.
4R6R: One whose heart is filled with jealousy of others, never comes to any good.
He in whose heart there is jealousy, for others never gathers any good.
41LE: No one pays any attention to what he says; he is just a fool, crying out endlessly in the wilderness.
None heeds what he says. He is a fool, ever crying in wilderness.
JZ6W: One whose heart is filled with malicious gossip, is known as a malicious gossip; everything he does is in vain.
He in whose heart is back-biting is known as a back-biter, Everything he has done or he does goes in vain.
52LJ: Night and day, he continually gossips about others; his face has been blackened, and he cannot show it to anyone.
He ever back-bites others, he cannot show his face to any one as it has become black.
KQDG: The body is the field of action, in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga; as you plant, so shall you harvest.
In the dark age the body is the field of actions. As one sows there in so does he eat.
Q5BU: Justice is not passed on mere words; if someone eats poison, he dies.
Justice is not administered on mere talk. By eating poison one dies forthwith.
GZ5S: O Siblings of Destiny, behold the justice of the True Creator; as people act, so they are rewarded.
My brethren behold the justice of the True Creator, As any one acts so is his reward.
X6H7: The Lord has bestowed total understanding upon servant Nanak; he speaks and proclaims the words of the Lord's Court. ||1||
God as imparted all understanding to servant Nanak and he explain the words of His court.
1SA9: Those who separate themselves from the Guru, in spite of His Constant Presence - they find no place of rest in the Court of the Lord.
They who are separated from the Guru who is present with them find no refuge in God's court.
HFN3: If someone goes to meet with those dull-faced slanderers, he will find their faces covered with spit.
If some one goes and meets those slanderers with insipid faces. He will find all spume on their mouth.
1LAL: Those who are cursed by the True Guru, are cursed by all the world. They wander around endlessly.
They who are cursed by the True Guru are accursed of the whole world and ever remain
77A3: Those who do not publicly affirm their Guru wander around, moaning and groaning.
They who publicly own not their Guru, wander about loudly groaning.
GYGA: Their hunger shall never depart; afflicted by constant hunger, they cry out in pain.
Their hunger never departs and stricken with hunger and want they ever, shriek aloud.
CM4A: No one hears what they have to say; they live in constant fear and terror, until they finally die.
None hears what they say. They are ever dying in dire dread.
5XD1: They cannot bear the glorious greatness of the True Guru, and they find no place of rest, here or hereafter.
They cannot bear the True Guru's greatness. They find no shelter here and here-after.
QZVJ: Those who go out to meet with those who have been cursed by the True Guru, lose all remnants of their honor.
Whosoever goes to meet those blighted by the True loses all the remnant of his honour.

16P5: They have already become like lepers; cursed by the Guru, whoever meets them is also afflicted with leprosy.
Cursed by the Guru they, they have already become lepers whosoever meets them is afflicted with leprosy.
NPGC: O Lord, I pray that I may not even catch sight of those, who focus their consciousness on the love of duality.
My God! I see not the sight of those who fix their mind on another's love.
ALNW: That which the Creator pre-ordained from the very beginning - there can be no escape from that.
There is no escape from that what the Creator Himself wrote in the beginning.
CV2Q: O servant Nanak, worship and adore the Naam, the Name of the Lord; no one can equal it.
O servant Nanak meditate you on God's Name whom none can equal.
5JKA: Great is the greatness of His Name; it increases, day by day. ||2||
Great is the greatness of Lord's Name and day by day, it goes on increasing.
QZM4: Great is the greatness of that humble being, whom the Guru Himself anointed in His Presence.
Magnificent is the greatness of the person whom Guru (Angad Dev) in his presence anointed as the Guru.
GV17: All the world comes and bows to him, falling at his feet. His praises spread throughout the world.
The world bows to him all fall at his feet. His praise is filling the world.
V0DG: The galaxies and solar systems bow in reverence to him; the Perfect Guru has placed His hand upon his head, and he has become perfect.
To him the continents and universe make obeisance. He, on whose forehead the Perfect Guru places his hand becomes perfect.
T2J4: The glorious greatness of the Guru increases day by day; no one can equal it.
The greatness of the Guru increases with each day. None can equal it.
DL93: O servant Nanak, the Creator Lord Himself established him; God preserves his honor. ||3||
O Slave, Nanak God the Creator Himself appointed (Guru Amar Das) and Himself the Lord preserves his honour.
7MZ2: The human body is a great fortress, with its shops and streets within.
The human body is a grand fort, with shops therein.
1YUY: The Gurmukh who comes to trade gathers the cargo of the Lord's Name.
The Guru-ward, who comes to trade takes care of the cargo of God's Name.
A4TW: He deals in the treasure of the Lord's Name, the jewels and the diamonds.
We should purchase the treasure of the jewels and corals of God's Name.
BJK5: Those who search for this treasure outside of the body, in other places, are foolish demons.
They who search the Lord's riches, outside, the body at any other place are the foolish devils.
L5DU: They wander around in the wilderness of doubt, like the deer who searches for the musk in the bushes. ||15||
In doubt they wander about in wilderness like the deer who searches for the musk in the bushes.
XMEP: One who slanders the Perfect True Guru, shall have difficulty in this world.
He who calumniates the Perfect True Guru, runs into difficulty in this world.
0VAZ: He is caught and thrown into the most horrible hell, the well of pain and suffering.
He is caught and thrown into the terrible hell a well of miseries.
136G: No one listens to his shrieks and cries; he cries out in pain and misery.
No one listens to his cries and lamentation. He becomes miserable and bewails.
E6PV: He totally loses this world and the next; he has lost all of his investment and profit.
He wholly loses this world and the next one. The capital and profit all he has lost.
UH5N: He is like the ox at the oil-press; each morning when he rises, God places the yoke upon him.
He is like the bullock of an oil man. His Master ever yokes him when he rises in the morning
T0CG: The Lord always sees and hears everything; nothing can be concealed from Him.
God ever sees and hears everything. Nothing remains concealed from him.
EHXP: As you plant, so shall you harvest, according to what you planted in the past.
As man sows so shall he reap, as he is reaping now what he formerly sowed.
ZRFH: One who is blessed by God's Grace washes the feet of the True Guru.
He to whom the Lord shows His mercy, washes the feet of the True Guru.
YG5Z: He is carried across by the Guru, the True Guru, like iron which is carried across by wood.
Like iron attached with timber he floats across in the wake of the Great True Guru.
NAHM: O servant Nanak, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, peace is obtained. ||1||
O slave Nanak, meditate you On the Name. By repeating the Name of Lord God peace is obtained.
AW7H: Very fortunate is the soul-bride, who, as Gurmukh, meets the Lord, her King.
Very fortunate are the brides who through the Guru, have met their Lord the King.
M12X: Her inner being is illiminated with His Divine Light; O Nanak, she is absorbed in His Name. ||2||
Nanak God's light has illumined their heartland they are absorbed in His Name.
U4HX: This body is the home of Dharma; the Divine Light of the True Lord is within it.
This body in whose heart is the light of the True One is wholly meant to practise virtue.
PQGG: Hidden within it are the jewels of mystery; how rare is that Gurmukh, that selfless servant, who digs them out.
Within it are hid the mysterious jewels. Some rare slave through the Guru mines them out.
N59M: When someone realizes the All-pervading Soul, then he sees the One and Only Lord permeating, through and through.
When the mortal realises the All-pervading soul then does he see the One Lord contained everywhere and the only One interwoven like warp and woof.
UUDN: He sees the One, he believes in the One, and with his ears, he listens only to the One.
He sees the One Lord he believers in the One Lord and with his ears he hears the tidings of the Lord alone.

S5B4: O servant Nanak, praise the Naam, the Name of the Lord; this is your service to the Lord, the Truest of the True. ||16||
Praise you the Lord's Name O slave Nanak This is your service of the Truest of the True.
L4CK: All joy is in the hearts of those, within whose minds the Lord abides.
All the pleasures are in the mind of those within whose heart God abides.
LEYA: In the Court of the Lord, their faces are radiant, and everyone goes to see them.
In God's court their faces are bright and all go to see them.
67EY: Those who meditate on the Name of the Fearless Lord have no fear.
They who meditate on the Name of the Fearless One have no fear.
HVK7: Those who have such pre-destined destiny remember the Sublime Lord.
They who are so pre-ordained, remember the Sublime Lord.
MTC8: Those, within whose minds the Lord abides, are robed with honor in the Court of the Lord.
They in whose heart God abides are robed in God's court.
AHKF: They are carried across, along with all their family, and the whole world is saved along with them.
They swim across with their entire family and in their wake the hole world is saved.
3WXT: O Lord, please unite servant Nanak with Your humble servants; beholding them, beholding them, I live. ||1||
My God unite the servant Nanak with Yours slaves by continually beholding whom he sustains life
P218: That land, where my True Guru comes and sits, becomes green and fertile.
That Land where my True Guru comes and sits grows green.
JN1Y: Those beings who go and behold my True Guru are rejuvenated.
The creatures who go and see my True Guru become reverdured.
7FZ3: Blessed, blessed is the father; blessed, blessed is the family; blessed, blessed is the mother, who gave birth to the Guru.
O Mother hail, hail to the father hail, hail to the family hail, hail, to the good mamma, who gave birth to the Guru.
Y6W4: Blessed, blessed is the Guru, who worships and adores the Naam; He saves Himself, and emancipates those who see Him.
Blessed, blessed is the Guru, who meditate on the Name He saves himself and saves those who see him.
BA0X: O Lord, be kind, and unite me with the True Guru, that servant Nanak may wash His feet. ||2||
O God mercifully cause me to meet the True Guru, that servant Nanak may wash his feet.
TL7U: Truest of the True is the Immortal True Guru; He has enshrined the Lord deep within His heart.
Truest of the true is the immortal Satguru, who has treasures up God within his heart.
VZKP: Truest of the True is the True Guru, the Primal Being, who has conquered sexual desire, anger and corruption.
Truest of the true is the omnipotent Satguru, who has killed lust, wrath and vice.
4T7J: When I see the Perfect True Guru, then deep within, my mind is comforted and consoled.
When I see the perfect Satguru, then, my mind, inwardly, secures support.
7MMS: I am a sacrifice to my True Guru; I am devoted and dedicated to Him, forever and ever.
I am a sacrifice to my Guru and am ever and ever devoted and dedicated to him.
13DZ: A Gurmukh wins the battle of life whereas a self-willed manmukh loses it. ||17||
The Guru-wards win the life game and the self-wards lose it.
LM8E: By His Grace, He leads us to meet the True Guru; then, as Gurmukh, we chant the Lord's Name, and meditate on it.
He, whom, by His grace the Lord introduces to the True Guru through the Guru, utters the Name, with his mouth.
7R8E: We do that which pleases the True Guru; the Perfect Guru comes to dwell in the home of the heart.
He does what pleases the true Guru, and the Perfect Guru gives him seat in his home.
MH15: Those who have the treasure of the Naam deep within - all their fears are removed.
The Lord removes all the fear of those, who have the Name treasure in their heart.
EJ0Z: They are protected by the Lord Himself; others struggle and fight against them, but they only come to death.
Many bother, worry and die in trying to harm those whom the Lord Himself protects.
0ABD: O servant Nanak, meditate on the Naam; the Lord shall deliver you, here and hereafter. ||1||
O servant Nanak, remember you the Name and the Lord shall deliver you here and hereafter.
K09M: The glorious greatness of the Guru, the True Guru, is pleasing to the GurSikh's mind.
The glory of the great True Guru is pleasing to the mind of the Guru's Sikhs.
5G8T: The Lord preserves the honor of the True Guru, which increases day by day.
God preserves the True Guru's honour which increases with each day.
DS12: The Supreme Lord God is in the Mind of the Guru, the True Guru; the Supreme Lord God saves Him.
In the mind of the great Satguru abides the Transcendent Lord and the Transcendent Lord protects him.
N2K6: The Lord is the Power and Support of the Guru, the True Guru; all come to bow before Him.
Of the great Satguru God is the power and prop. He has brought all to bow before him.
ET3D: Those who have gazed lovingly upon my True Guru - all their sins are taken away.
The Lord effaces all the sins of those who have seen my True Guru with love.
2FPK: Their faces are radiant in the Court of the Lord, and they obtain great glory.
Bright become their countenances in God's court and they get great glory.
AFQM: Servant Nanak begs for the dust of the feet of those GurSikhs, O my Siblings of Destiny. ||2||
Servant Nanak, asks for the dust of those brethren of his who are the disciples of the Guru.
PRAD: I chant the Praises and Glories of the True One. True is the glorious greatness of the True Lord.
I utter and eulogise the praise of the True One. True is the glory of the True Lord.
F6PM: I praise the True Lord, and the Praises of the True Lord. His worth cannot be estimated.
I eulogise the True Lord and the praise of the True Lord. None knows the worth of the True one.
